name: neural-clash
description: Neural Clash: a creature RPG where your companion is a neural network you implement and train

scripts.dev: npm run stage:pyodide && npm run stage:clang && next dev
scripts.build: npm run stage:pyodide && npm run stage:clang && next build
scripts.build:pages: npm run stage:pyodide && npm run stage:clang && STATIC_EXPORT=1 BASE_PATH=${BASE_PATH-/neural-clash} next build && BASE_PATH=${BASE_PATH-/neural-clash} node scripts/gen-sw.mjs
